item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 03/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Under the influence of upper-air disturbances, the weather will be unsettled over southern China during the weekend. There will be showers with squally thunderstorms. An anticyclone aloft will bring hot and brighter weather to the coast of Guangdong on Monday and Tuesday. Another surge of the easterly airstream is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Wednesday. There will be a few showers over the region. It will be windier over the coastal areas in the following couple of days.
